Late at night, she scrolls through an online forum where kids her age talk about puberty—periods, bras, body hair, and what it’s like to start feeling “crush” feelings. She mostly reads at first, relieved that other people are also confused, but she keeps coming across comments where older teens casually mention things like “hooking up,” “doing it,” or “finishing,” as if it’s just another part of growing up.
